nonclaims: No C compilation or execution was performed by this reviewer.

This diagnostic can assess only two current PID records; it cannot establish full-table provider completeness, process absence, historical ownership, PID nonreuse, qualification, or native06 activation.

observed_declarations: sysctl.h defines CTL_KERN=1, KERN_PROC=14, KERN_PROC_PID=1, struct kinfo_proc.kp_proc and kp_eproc.e_ppid, and declares sysctl(int *, u_int, ..., size_t *, ..., size_t).
proc.h exposes p_starttime, p_stat, p_pid, p_comm[MAXCOMLEN + 1] and SIDL through SZOMB state constants; it includes sys/param.h and sys/time.h.
param.h defines MAXCOMLEN=16; sys/_types defines __darwin_pid_t as __int32_t and the pid_t header aliases pid_t to it.

error_and_identity_limits.evidence: Any syscall rc failure or returned-length mismatch yields a nonzero result and no accept marker. Missing/inaccessible PID is not labeled absent. A successful PID 10491 query could describe a reused current PID only; it does not prove identity or ownership of the historical process.

output_allowlist.evidence: Only requested/returned PID, PPID, birth seconds/useconds, numeric state, bounded p_comm bytes encoded as hex, syscall rc/errno/lengths, and uname platform strings are emitted. No pointer/address, credential, argv, full path, or other kinfo_proc member is printed. The full SDK record exists transiently in memory because sysctl fills it.
output_allowlist.format_note: stdout is line-oriented key=value text, not JSON. Its values remain allowlisted and bounded; if machine-readable JSON stdout is a literal capture requirement, change/normalize the format before using that ingestion path.

read_only_scope.evidence: MIB is CTL_KERN/KERN_PROC/KERN_PROC_PID/requested PID; oldp points to one stack struct kinfo_proc; newp is NULL and newlen is zero.

sdk_abi_and_validation.evidence: Uses SDK-defined struct kinfo_proc and named fields, SDK MIB/status constants, and sizeof(row); LP64/Apple guards are present. Header checks confirm int sysctl MIB signature, KERN_PROC_PID, p_pid/e_ppid/p_starttime/p_stat/p_comm, timeval, MAXCOMLEN+1, and pid_t is signed 32-bit in this SDK. The code rejects syscall errors, nonexact returned length, mismatched or nonpositive PID, negative PPID, invalid birth time, out-of-range process state, empty command, and unterminated p_comm.

timeout_and_invocation_boundary.evidence: The C source has no internal timeout, but README supplies a five-second alarm wrapper around only the one binary invocation. Compile and execution were not performed for this review. The allowed invocation must remain an ordinary-user run and must not be repeated on error.

two_targeted_queries_only.evidence: One sysctl callsite is invoked exactly twice: fixed PID 10491 and getpid(); main(void) accepts no CLI args; no process-table query, loop, retry, signal, kill, privilege change, or elevated-privilege path exists.
